lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，竞技场跟着震
lines.en: I shift one step at a time and the arena shakes.

lines.zh: 脚下是冥界的石砖，缝里发紫
lines.en: Netherworld flagstones under me, purple in the seams.

lines.zh: 走不出这片场地，我也懒得走
lines.en: I can't leave this arena, and I don't care to.

lines.zh: 剑拖在地上，划出一道亮痕
lines.en: My sword drags and leaves a bright line.

lines.zh: 我绕着场边走，盯着中间
lines.en: I circle the edge, watching the center.

lines.zh: 每一次落步，界线都亮一下
lines.en: Each step lights the boundary once.

lines.zh: 身体在飘，可这片地拽着我
lines.en: My body floats, yet this ground pulls at me.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，你还有时间
lines.en: I walk slowly; you still have time.

lines.zh: 碎屑自己往我脚边聚
lines.en: Debris gathers itself at my feet.

lines.zh: 这是我醒来的第几步，我忘了
lines.en: I forget how many steps since waking.

lines.zh: 还睡着的时候，我什么都不想
lines.en: While asleep, I think of nothing.

lines.zh: 石台上有我的形状
lines.en: My shape is worn into the stone platform.

lines.zh: 我在这里很久了
lines.en: I've been here a very long time.

lines.zh: 身体的裂纹一张一合
lines.en: The cracks in my body open and close.

lines.zh: 血条在你们眼里，我自己看不见
lines.en: You see my bar; I can't see it myself.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，空气都冷了
lines.en: I yawn and the air turns cold.

lines.zh: 没人来的时候，我就沉下去
lines.en: When no one comes, I sink back down.

lines.zh: 这竞技场的边，我摸过很多次
lines.en: I've touched this arena's edges many times.

lines.zh: 醒一会儿，又想睡
lines.en: Awake a while, then sleepy again.

lines.zh: 空间在我身边缓慢地响
lines.en: Space rings slowly around me.

lines.zh: 他们把我放在这里，让我睡
lines.en: They put me here and let me sleep.

lines.zh: 来人之前，我一直是雕像
lines.en: Until someone comes, I'm a statue.

lines.zh: 我把剑插在石缝里
lines.en: I plant my sword in a stone seam.

lines.zh: 这一块地归我，谁也别想拿走
lines.en: This plot is mine; no one takes it.

lines.zh: 安静的冥界，只有我在呼吸
lines.en: A quiet underworld, and only I breathe.

lines.zh: 醒来的那一刻，最难受
lines.en: The moment of waking is the worst.

lines.zh: 你踏进来了，就别想出去
lines.en: You stepped in; don't plan on leaving.

lines.zh: 这么小一个人，也敢站在这
lines.en: Such a small person, standing here.

lines.zh: 我看你有几斤气
lines.en: Let me see how much ki you carry.

lines.zh: 门已经在你们身后关了
lines.en: The gate closed behind you already.

lines.zh: 抬头，我比这石柱高
lines.en: Look up; I'm taller than these pillars.

lines.zh: 我不急，我等了一万年
lines.en: I'm in no hurry; I've waited ten thousand years.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑，比我的短
lines.en: Your blade is shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 你们来了几个，一起上
lines.en: How many of you came? Come all at once.

lines.zh: 这片场地的规则，是我定的
lines.en: I set the rules of this arena.

lines.zh: 你的影子贴在地上，动不了
lines.en: Your shadow is stuck to the floor.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，地会变重
lines.en: When I look at you, the ground grows heavy.

lines.zh: 别装勇敢，你的腿在抖
lines.en: Don't pretend courage; your legs shake.

lines.zh: 我被你们打退了一步
lines.en: You pushed me back one step.

lines.zh: 血条晃了一下，我看见了
lines.en: My bar flickered; I saw it.

lines.zh: 这点伤，睡一觉就好
lines.en: This much heals with a sleep.

lines.zh: 身体的裂缝又开了一处
lines.en: Another crack opened in my body.

lines.zh: 我笑了，笑声在墙上回来
lines.en: I laughed and it came back off the walls.

lines.zh: 你们一起打，才有点意思
lines.en: Hitting together makes it interesting.

lines.zh: 我站直了，地又沉下去
lines.en: I straighten and the floor sinks again.

lines.zh: 疼，但这场才刚开始
lines.en: It hurts, and this is only the start.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，把伤口按住
lines.en: I raise a hand and press the wound shut.

lines.zh: 你们的伤害，我记着账
lines.en: I'm keeping account of your damage.

lines.zh: 冥界的石台不收你的供品。
lines.en: The stone altar of the underworld takes no offerings.

lines.zh: 甜味在冥界是假的
lines.en: Sweetness is a lie in the underworld.

lines.zh: 这东西该喂给外面的活物
lines.en: Feed that to the living outside.

lines.zh: 我只想要你的气
lines.en: I only want your ki.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在石台上，然后走
lines.en: Set it on the platform, then leave.

lines.zh: 我看了那东西一眼，没兴趣
lines.en: I glanced at it; no interest.

lines.zh: 这片场地里的东西，我不碰
lines.en: I don't touch things in this arena.

lines.zh: 诱饵对我不起作用
lines.en: Bait has no effect on me.

lines.zh: 你把命留下，比什么都好
lines.en: Leave your life; that's worth more.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手，东西就没了
lines.en: I lift a hand and it's gone.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你会被弹到墙边
lines.en: Hit me and you'll bounce to the wall.

lines.zh: 我的身体不实在，你却会疼
lines.en: My body isn't solid, yet you'll hurt.

lines.zh: 别贴着我的腿
lines.en: Don't press against my leg.

lines.zh: 这一下，地面裂了
lines.en: The floor cracked with that.

lines.zh: 让开，我要绕场一圈
lines.en: Step aside, I'm circling the arena.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，还是会退
lines.en: You took three steps; you'll take more.

lines.zh: 踩过我脚下的界线，就出去了
lines.en: Cross the line under my feet and you're out.

lines.zh: 别挡在剑的前面
lines.en: Don't stand in front of the sword.

lines.zh: 碰撞在这里像回声
lines.en: Collisions here echo.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我半步
lines.en: You cost me half a step.

lines.zh: 我是被放在这里的，不会有伴
lines.en: I was placed here; there will be no partner.

lines.zh: 这竞技场只容一个
lines.en: This arena holds only one.

lines.zh: 另一个我，会被我吞掉
lines.en: Another me would be swallowed.

lines.zh: 我睡了这么久，谁也没来
lines.en: I slept this long and no one came.

lines.zh: 空间里没有第二个位置
lines.en: There's no second place in this space.

lines.zh: 别问，问了我也不答
lines.en: Don't ask; I wouldn't answer.

lines.zh: 这具身体是被人拼起来的
lines.en: This body was pieced together by others.

lines.zh: 我做不了那种事
lines.en: I can't do that sort of thing.

lines.zh: 我看了看四周，只有石头
lines.en: I look around; there's only stone.

lines.zh: 你还站在这儿，是想看什么
lines.en: You're still standing there; what do you want to see?

lines.zh: 地上掉的，都是战利品
lines.en: What falls here is all spoils.

lines.zh: 我伸手，东西就浮起来
lines.en: I reach out and the thing floats up.

lines.zh: 这些不属于你
lines.en: These don't belong to you.

lines.zh: 我不捡，我只收
lines.en: I don't pick up, I collect.

lines.zh: 放在石台上，我就收下
lines.en: Set it on the platform and I'll take it.

lines.zh: 那点东西，不够我抬手
lines.en: Not worth lifting my hand.

lines.zh: 掉在这里的东西，都归我
lines.en: Whatever drops in here belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我看了它一眼，它就没了
lines.en: I glance at it and it's gone.

lines.zh: 手指穿过它，它落回地上
lines.en: My fingers pass through and it falls back.

lines.zh: 你们抢的，最后都是我的
lines.en: Whatever you fight over is mine in the end.

lines.zh: 醒了，终于有人来了
lines.en: Awake; someone has finally come.

lines.zh: 这一口气，我等了很久
lines.en: I've waited a long time for this breath.

lines.zh: 先把场地封住
lines.en: First, seal the arena.

lines.zh: 裂隙从脚下往你那边爬
lines.en: A fissure crawls from my feet toward you.

lines.zh: 你的位置，我记得很清楚
lines.en: I remember your position clearly.

lines.zh: 气功屏障先立起来
lines.en: A ki barrier goes up first.

lines.zh: 剑拔出来的时候会响很长
lines.en: When the sword comes free, it rings a long time.

lines.zh: 一个一个来，别挤
lines.en: One at a time, don't crowd.

lines.zh: 他的气在抖，很好
lines.en: His ki is trembling, good.

lines.zh: 这一场，只会有一个人留下
lines.en: Only one will remain in this match.

lines.zh: 巨猿咆哮在胸口攒着
lines.en: A giant ape's roar gathers in my chest.

lines.zh: 空间开始往中间挤
lines.en: Space starts pressing inward.

lines.zh: 那条路，我封了
lines.en: I've sealed that route.

lines.zh: 他站在界线附近，正合适
lines.en: He stands near the boundary, perfect.

lines.zh: 我看他一眼，他就该动不了
lines.en: One look from me and he shouldn't move.

lines.zh: 场地中央归我
lines.en: The center of the arena is mine.

lines.zh: 最后一个人留下时，我才会坐下
lines.en: I'll only sit down when one is left.

lines.zh: 他在绕，我也不动
lines.en: He circles, and I don't.

lines.zh: 巨猿光束要蓄满四息
lines.en: The ape beam needs four breaths.

lines.zh: 空间一收一放，闲人站不稳
lines.en: Space flexes and the uninvited can't stand.

lines.zh: 他的盾挡不住上面
lines.en: His shield won't cover above.

lines.zh: 再靠近两步，我就出手
lines.en: Two steps closer and I strike.

lines.zh: 破坏球在手里变重
lines.en: The destruction ball grows heavy in my hand.

lines.zh: 他退到墙边了，没有路
lines.en: He's at the wall with nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 我拖着剑走半步，声先到
lines.en: I drag my sword half a step; the sound arrives first.

lines.zh: 这一场打得很慢，我喜欢慢
lines.en: This fight is slow, and I like slow.

lines.zh: 他的同伴在看他
lines.en: His companions are watching him.

lines.zh: 我不追，跑到边界就回来了
lines.en: I don't chase; at the boundary they come back.

lines.zh: 脚下的裂纹成了一张网
lines.en: The cracks under my feet have become a net.

lines.zh: 他抬手了，那是要放招
lines.en: He raised his hand; he's about to fire.

lines.zh: 我先放屏障，慢慢耗他
lines.en: I raise the barrier first and wear him down.

lines.zh: 这一片空气，我全占了
lines.en: I've taken all the air in this space.

lines.zh: 数他的喘气，一次比一次重
lines.en: Counting his breaths; each one heavier.

lines.zh: 地上的影子已经被我按住
lines.en: I've pinned the shadows on the ground.

lines.zh: 他往后一跳，落点我早知道
lines.en: He leaps back; I knew where he'd land.

lines.zh: 再等一息，等他站着不动
lines.en: One more breath, until he stands still.

lines.zh: 就是现在，剑落下
lines.en: Now, the sword comes down.

lines.zh: 剑落下去，石台裂开
lines.en: The sword falls and the platform splits.

lines.zh: 蓄气突击撞在墙上
lines.en: My charged rush slams him into the wall.

lines.zh: 魔人拳砸下去，地陷半格
lines.en: The Majin punch sinks the floor half a block.

lines.zh: 空中连击从上面压下来
lines.en: An aerial combo presses down from above.

lines.zh: 巨猿咆哮把你们一起推远
lines.en: The ape roar pushes all of you back.

lines.zh: 破坏球炸开，碎石四处飞
lines.en: The destruction ball bursts and rubble flies.

lines.zh: 屏障一合，他退了半步
lines.en: The barrier closes and he's half a step back.

lines.zh: 我挥剑的弧线很慢，但很长
lines.en: My swing is slow, but it reaches far.

lines.zh: 他被扫到墙边，站起来了
lines.en: He was swept to the wall and got up.

lines.zh: 第二下就重了
lines.en: The second one is heavy.

lines.zh: 我转身，剑跟着转
lines.en: I turn, and the sword turns with me.

lines.zh: 场边的界线上，血在发亮
lines.en: Blood on the boundary line glows.

lines.zh: 收剑，等他再来一次
lines.en: I draw back and wait for him to try again.

lines.zh: 冥界的竞技场先亮起来
lines.en: The underworld arena lights up first.

lines.zh: 石台中央，我缓缓站起来
lines.en: In the platform's center, I rise slowly.

lines.zh: 很久没人来了，我睡得很沉
lines.en: No one came for so long I slept deeply.

lines.zh: 头顶的血条亮起时，我才算醒
lines.en: My bar lights up, and only then am I awake.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，四周的石头都在响
lines.en: I open my eyes and the stones all ring.

lines.zh: 门在你们身后关上
lines.en: The gate shuts behind you.

lines.zh: 这一场是为你们准备的
lines.en: This match was prepared for you.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的灰，灰很厚
lines.en: I shake off the dust; it's thick.

lines.zh: 空间裂开的缝，先在我脚下
lines.en: The cracks open under my feet first.

lines.zh: 有人走进来了，我感觉得到
lines.en: Someone has walked in; I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，剑还在石缝里
lines.en: I raise my head; the sword is still in the stone.

lines.zh: 这个场地，我熟悉每一块砖
lines.en: I know every brick of this arena.

lines.zh: 醒来的第一件事，是找你们
lines.en: The first thing on waking is to find you.

lines.zh: 我站起来的时候，天花板低了
lines.en: When I stand, the ceiling feels low.

lines.zh: 紫黑的气从地缝里涌出来
lines.en: Purple-black ki pours from the floor seams.

lines.zh: 我来得不快，但你们跑不掉
lines.en: I'm not quick to arrive, but you can't escape.

lines.zh: 这不是自然生成的，这是安排
lines.en: This isn't natural spawning; it's arranged.

lines.zh: 我坐太久了，骨头都在响
lines.en: I've sat too long; my bones are ringing.

lines.zh: 这一场，观众就是你们
lines.en: In this match, the audience is you.

lines.zh: 火在冥界点不长久
lines.en: Fire doesn't last in the underworld.

lines.zh: 我从高台落下，地先碎
lines.en: I drop from the dais and the floor breaks first.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，那是别人的水
lines.en: There's no water here; that's someone else's.

lines.zh: 爆炸推着我的身体往后滑
lines.en: The blast slides my body backward.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我身上，像根针
lines.en: An arrow sticks in me like a pin.

lines.zh: 法术在我这具身体里找不到根
lines.en: The spell finds no root in this body.

lines.zh: 我睡了这么久，早就不饿了
lines.en: I slept this long; hunger left long ago.

lines.zh: 雷落进场中，紫光更盛
lines.en: Lightning strikes the arena and the purple deepens.

lines.zh: 这里离虚空很近，我不怕
lines.en: The void is near here; I don't fear it.
